name: Rao Sahib Peshwa

contribution: Rao Sahib Peshwa served as a Maratha rebel leader and ally of Tatya Tope during the 1857–58 campaigns in north-central India.

impact: His alliance with Tatya Tope shows the importance of Maratha political networks in sustaining resistance after the initial uprisings.
highlight: Rao Sahib Peshwa was a Maratha rebel leader allied with Tatya Tope during the 1857 rebellion.
